title: Leviathan Steam Turbine
description: The &3Leviathan Steam Turbine&r is a massive turbine capable of processing gargantuan amounts of &bSteam&r at once, only hindered by the fluid system's transfer rate. It is significantly more powerful than even the &3Industrial Steam Turbine&r in terms of raw steam processing power. This turbine runs on &e85%&r Efficiency, so it is recommended that only 1-2 are used for very large reactors.
